blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) is targeting the completion of ongoing works on the Metro Cebu Expressway (MCE) Segment 3A and three access road projects in Naga City by December 2027, subject to the approval of additional funding requested for next year.
